crossRefs.note: The sons of Moses: Gershom and Eliezer.
The sons of Gershom: Shebuel the chief.
Of the rest of the sons of Levi: of the sons of Amram, Shubael; of the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.

people.name: Gershom
people.line: Son of Moses; father of Jonathan, a renegade priest.

people.name: Moses
people.line: Prophet who led Israel out of Egypt

people.name: Shebuel
people.line: Levite descendant of Gershom, in charge of treasuries

translations.web: and Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler over the treasures.
translations.bsb: Shebuel, a descendant of Gershom son of Moses, was the officer in charge of the treasuries.
translations.kjv: And Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler of the treasures.
translations.asv: and Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler over the treasures.
